title: Inside AAON Season 2 Episode 10: Putting Our Customers First with Derby Juez-Perez
summary: Discover how AAON’s Customer Care team is improving processes and strengthening support for sales representatives in the latest Inside AAON episode.
body_markdown:
Over the past year, AAON has enhanced its support model to better serve our reps and customers. Reps called for clearer ownership, more timely communication, and stronger support, and Customer Care has played a key role in delivering on those expectations?


But what does success look like in Customer Care? Join us for today’s episode as special guest


Derby Juez-Perez, Director of Customer Care and Technical Support, returns to Inside AAON to


discuss the changes, updates, and improvements that Customer Care has made to better support our sales reps.


> “Customer Care and Technical Services (now) at AAON is a group of departments–conglomerative departments, that have the same vision,” said Juez-Perez. “That is to leverage our resources to the maximum of our abilities to take care of the customer and make their day-to-day easier to do business with AAON.”


Starting his AAON career at WattMaster in Kansas City before relocating to Tulsa to join the marketing team, Derby quickly recognized opportunities to enhance the Customer Care experience. Drawing on his sales expertise and customer-first mindset, he transitioned to the Customer Care Department, where he's worked relentlessly alongside his team to strengthen processes and make it easier for our reps to do business with AAON.


Learn more about the improvements Derby and his team have made in the season finale of Inside AAON.
